verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ ἀληθινή καὶ ὁ Πατήρ μου ὁ γεωργός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi hē ampelos hē alēthinē kai ho Patēr mou ho geōrgos estin
verses.literal: I am the true vine and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard

verses.original: πᾶν κλῆμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μὴ φέρον καρπὸν αἴρει αὐτό καὶ πᾶν τὸ καρπὸν φέρον καθαίρει αὐτὸ ἵνα καρπὸν πλείονα φέρῃ
verses.transliteration: pan klēma en emoi mē pheron karpon airei auto kai pan to karpon pheron kathairei auto hina karpon pleiona pherē
verses.literal: He cuts off . . . every branch in Me that bears no fruit and every branch that does bear fruit He prunes to make it even more fruitful . . . . . .

verses.original: ἤδη ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε διὰ τὸν λόγον ὃν λελάληκα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ēdē hymeis katharoi este dia ton logon hon lelalēka hymin
verses.literal: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you

verses.original: μείνατε ἐν ἐμοί κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν καθὼς τὸ κλῆμα οὐ δύναται καρπὸν φέρειν ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἐὰν μὴ μένῃ ἐν τῇ ἀμπέλῳ οὕτως οὐδὲ ὑμεῖς ἐὰν μὴ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένητε
verses.transliteration: meinate en emoi kagō en hymin kathōs to klēma ou dynatai karpon pherein aph’ heautou ean mē menē en tē ampelō houtōs oude hymeis ean mē en emoi menēte
verses.literal: Remain in Me and I will remain in you Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless . . . it remains in the vine neither can you bear fruit unless . . . you remain in Me

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος ὑμεῖς τὰ κλήματα ὁ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ οὗτος φέρει καρπὸν πολύν ὅτι χωρὶς ἐμοῦ οὐ δύνασθε ποιεῖν οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi hē ampelos hymeis ta klēmata ho menōn en emoi kagō en autō houtos pherei karpon polyn hoti chōris emou ou dynasthe poiein ouden
verses.literal: I am the vine and you are the branches The one who remains in Me and I in him will bear much fruit For apart from Me you can do nothing

verses.original: ἐὰν μή τις μένῃ ἐν ἐμοί ἐβλήθη ἔξω ὡς τὸ κλῆμα καὶ ἐξηράνθη καὶ συνάγουσιν αὐτὰ καὶ εἰς τὸ πῦρ βάλλουσιν καὶ καίεται
verses.transliteration: ean mē tis menē en emoi eblēthē exō hōs to klēma kai exēranthē kai synagousin auta kai eis to pyr ballousin kai kaietai
verses.literal: If anyone does not remain in Me he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers Such branches are gathered up thrown into the fire and burned

verses.original: ἐὰν μείνητε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τὰ ῥήματά μου ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἐὰν θέλητε αἰτήσασθε καὶ γενήσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ean meinēte en emoi kai ta rhēmata mou en hymin meinē ho ean thelēte aitēsasthe kai genēsetai hymin
verses.literal: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you ask whatever you wish and it will be done for you

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ ἐδοξάσθη ὁ Πατήρ μου ἵνα καρπὸν πολὺν φέρητε καὶ γένησθε ἐμοὶ μαθηταί
verses.transliteration: en toutō edoxasthē ho Patēr mou hina karpon polyn pherēte kai genēsthe emoi mathētai
verses.literal: This is to My Father’s glory that you bear much fruit proving yourselves to be My disciples

verses.original: Καθὼς ἠγάπησέν με ὁ Πατήρ κἀγὼ ὑμᾶς ἠγάπησα μείνατε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐμῇ
verses.transliteration: Kathōs ēgapēsen me ho Patēr kagō hymas ēgapēsa meinate en tē agapē tē emē
verses.literal: As the Father has loved Me so have I loved you Remain in My love

verses.original: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου καθὼς ἐγὼ τοῦ Πατρός μου τὰς ἐντολὰς τετήρηκα καὶ μένω αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: ean tas entolas mou tērēsēte meneite en tē agapē mou kathōs egō tou Patros mou tas entolas tetērēka kai menō autou en tē agapē
verses.literal: If you keep My commandments you will remain in My love just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love

verses.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ ἐν ὑμῖν ᾖ καὶ ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν πληρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: Tauta lelalēka hymin hina hē chara hē emē en hymin ē kai hē chara hymōn plērōthē
verses.literal: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete

verses.original: Αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ ἐμὴ ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Hautē estin hē entolē hē emē hina agapate allēlous kathōs ēgapēsa hymas
verses.literal: This is My commandment that you love one another as I have loved you

verses.original: μείζονα ταύτης ἀγάπην οὐδεὶς ἔχει ἵνα τις τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ θῇ ὑπὲρ τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: meizona tautēs agapēn oudeis echei hina tis tēn psychēn autou thē hyper tōn philōn autou
verses.literal: Greater love has no one than this that he lay down his life for his friends

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς φίλοι μού ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Hymeis philoi mou este ean poiēte ha egō entellomai hymin
verses.literal: You are My friends if you do what I command you

verses.original: οὐκέτι λέγω ὑμᾶς δούλους ὅτι ὁ δοῦλος οὐκ οἶδεν τί ποιεῖ αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος ὑμᾶς δὲ εἴρηκα φίλους ὅτι πάντα ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου ἐγνώρισα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ouketi legō hymas doulous hoti ho doulos ouk oiden ti poiei autou ho kyrios hymas de eirēka philous hoti panta ha ēkousa para tou Patros mou egnōrisa hymin
verses.literal: No longer do I call you servants for a servant does not understand what his master is doing But I have called you friends because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you

verses.original: οὐχ ὑμεῖς με ἐξελέξασθε ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔθηκα ὑμᾶς ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑπάγητε καὶ καρπὸν φέρητε καὶ ὁ καρπὸς ὑμῶν μένῃ ἵνα ὅ¦τι ἂν αἰτήσητε τὸν Πατέρα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δῷ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ouch hymeis me exelexasthe all’ egō exelexamēn hymas kai ethēka hymas hina hymeis hypagēte kai karpon pherēte kai ho karpos hymōn menē hina ho¦ti an aitēsēte ton Patera en tō onomati mou dō hymin
verses.literal: You did not choose Me but I chose you And I appointed you to go and bear fruit - fruit that will remain so that whatever you ask the Father in My name He will give you

verses.original: ταῦτα ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: tauta entellomai hymin hina agapate allēlous
verses.literal: This is My command to you Love one another

verses.original: Εἰ ὁ κόσμος ὑμᾶς μισεῖ γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐμὲ πρῶτον ὑμῶν μεμίσηκεν
verses.transliteration: Ei ho kosmos hymas misei ginōskete hoti eme prōton hymōn memisēken
verses.literal: If the world hates you understand that it hated Me first . . .

verses.original: εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἦτε ὁ κόσμος ἂν τὸ ἴδιον ἐφίλει ὅτι δὲ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ ἐστέ ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου διὰ τοῦτο μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος
verses.transliteration: ei ek tou kosmou ēte ho kosmos an to idion ephilei hoti de ek tou kosmou ouk este all’ egō exelexamēn hymas ek tou kosmou dia touto misei hymas ho kosmos
verses.literal: If you were of the world it would love you as its own Instead the world hates you because . . . you are not of the world but I have chosen you out of the world

verses.original: Μνημονεύετε τοῦ λόγου οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν Οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ εἰ ἐμὲ ἐδίωξαν καὶ ὑμᾶς διώξουσιν εἰ τὸν λόγον μου ἐτήρησαν καὶ τὸν ὑμέτερον τηρήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneuete tou logou hou egō eipon hymin Ouk estin doulos meizōn tou kyriou autou ei eme ediōxan kai hymas diōxousin ei ton logon mou etērēsan kai ton hymeteron tērēsousin
verses.literal: Remember the word that I spoke to you No servant is greater than his master If they persecuted Me they will persecute you as well if they kept My word they will keep yours as well

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα πάντα ποιήσουσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: alla tauta panta poiēsousin eis hymas dia to onoma mou hoti ouk oidasin ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: But they will treat . . . you like this because of My name since they do not know the One who sent Me

verses.original: εἰ μὴ ἦλθον καὶ ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν νῦν δὲ πρόφασιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ei mē ēlthon kai elalēsa autois hamartian ouk eichosan nyn de prophasin ouk echousin peri tēs hamartias autōn
verses.literal: If I had not come and spoken to them they would not be guilty of sin . . . Now however they have no excuse for their sin

verses.original: Ὁ ἐμὲ μισῶν καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου μισεῖ
verses.transliteration: Ho eme misōn kai ton Patera mou misei
verses.literal: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well

verses.original: εἰ τὰ ἔργα μὴ ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἃ οὐδεὶς ἄλλος ἐποίησεν ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν νῦν δὲ καὶ ἑωράκασιν καὶ μεμισήκασιν καὶ ἐμὲ καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου
verses.transliteration: ei ta erga mē epoiēsa en autois ha oudeis allos epoiēsen hamartian ouk eichosan nyn de kai heōrakasin kai memisēkasin kai eme kai ton Patera mou
verses.literal: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did they would not be guilty of sin . . . but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτῶν γεγραμμένος ὅτι Ἐμίσησάν με δωρεάν
verses.transliteration: all’ hina plērōthē ho logos ho en tō nomō autōn gegrammenos hoti Emisēsan me dōrean
verses.literal: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law They hated Me without reason

verses.original: Ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ Παράκλητος ὃν ἐγὼ πέμψω ὑμῖν παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ παρὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐκπορεύεται ἐκεῖνος μαρτυρήσει περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan elthē ho Paraklētos hon egō pempsō hymin para tou Patros to Pneuma tēs alētheias ho para tou Patros ekporeuetai ekeinos martyrēsei peri emou
verses.literal: When the Advocate comes whom I will send to you from the Father the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father He will testify about Me

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς δὲ μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστε
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis de martyreite hoti ap’ archēs met’ emou este
verses.literal: And you also must testify because you have been with Me from the beginning
